correctness.rationale: For each n>=1 and all nonempty U,V, Boolean multiplication yields U×W and Z×V. Their equality has exactly the zero/zero and nonzero/matching-support cases. The zero/zero case leaves (n-a)(n-b) arbitrary bits; in the other case, the A×A block has H_c options with no zero rows/columns, B×U has (2^a-1)^(a-c) options, V×C has (2^b-1)^(b-c), and precisely the same free-bit rectangle remains. Inclusion-exclusion proves H_c and choosing support-overlap strata proves M_n. n<=3 all rectangles and n=4 all 26 overlap representatives are verified against all matrices by direct independent multiplication. Standard pairwise-intersection bounds prove the asymptotic.

originality.rationale: The rank-one rectangular element and product rule are established. The new result enumerates all arbitrary-rank partners commuting with each such element and gives the complete overlap-indexed size multiplicities and limiting contrast. Published rank-one idempotent clique counts enumerate only mutual commutation within a narrow subgraph, not this full centralizer; the full semigroup-algebra rectangle ideal describes a different linearized object. Exact statement and parameter-implication comparisons did not find prior coverage in inspected sources. The absence of an earlier equivalent formula remains a specific residual historical-priority risk.
residual_risks: Unlocated earlier relation-algebra/multifunction terminology may conceal an equivalent overlap-indexed commuting-partner count.

value.rationale: Determines the complete multiset of commuting-partner counts on the entire minimal nonzero Boolean-rank stratum of an exponentially large finite semigroup, for every n. The exact overlap dependence is not captured by fixed support sizes alone (n=4,a=b=2,c=0,1,2 yields 1312,160,128), and singleton versus complete-rectangle commuting probabilities have opposite limits; these are natural structural, quantitative invariants and not a standalone finite-table exercise.
